served.stem: According to the passage, all of the following could be read from Photo 51 EXCEPT:
choices: the distance the helix climbs in one full turn
the fact that the molecule is a helix
the number of chains in the molecule
served.bankWhy: Paragraph 6 lists what the picture gave: a helix, the 34 angstrom rise per turn, the 3.4 angstrom spacing between bases, and the 20 angstrom diameter. Paragraph 12 says outright that it did not say how many chains there were.
